name: prompts.chat
description: f.k.a. Awesome ChatGPT Prompts. Share, discover, and collect prompts from the community. Free and open source — self-host for your organization with complete privacy.
one_liner: A community-built library of ready-made prompts for AI chatbots, so you can copy a well-tested instruction instead of writing one from scratch — and companies can run their own private version.
buyer: A company that wants an internal, private library of vetted prompts for its team to reuse, without sending that library through a public third-party site.
business_use_cases: A marketing agency self-hosts it as an internal prompt library so account managers reuse proven prompts instead of reinventing them.
A training company packages curated prompt sets from it as part of a paid 'AI literacy for teams' course.
A SaaS company builds a niche prompt marketplace on top of the same idea for a specific profession (e.g. real estate agents).

money_ideas.idea: Curate and sell a premium, industry-specific prompt pack (e.g. 'prompts for real estate agents') as a one-time digital product.
Offer a hosted, private-labeled version for companies that want their own internal prompt library, billed per seat.

steal_this: This weekend, curate 30 prompts for one specific profession, package them as a paid PDF or Notion doc, and sell it directly to that audience.
